snippet.title: The You Quiz - Game trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist TheYou Quiz https://store.steampowered.com/app/3669740/480?utm_source=youtube

A multiplayer trivia game but questions are about the players! One player is the King, and the others are Courtiers. Courtiers answer personal questions about the King, and the King picks the most accurate, or funniest answer. Play online or locally, up to 8 players.

Coming out later in 2025
